stem: Why is finance called the 'life blood' of any business?
options: No business activity can be carried out without adequate funds
Finance is the only resource a business needs to operate
Funds invested in a business can never be withdrawn later
Every business must borrow from a bank before it is allowed to start
explanation: Correct option: (A). Business requires money for carrying out its various activities, and a business cannot function unless adequate funds are available; hence finance is called its life blood. Finance is not the only resource (men, materials and machines are also needed), funds can be withdrawn or repaid, and a business may start with owner's capital without any bank loan.

stem: Firm X sells its goods only for cash and has a fast sales turnover. Firm Y sells mostly on credit and has a slow sales turnover. Which statement is correct?

Both firms will need the same amount of working capital

stem: Read the case of Sunrise Foods Ltd. Considering its fluctuating profits, high tax rate and the promoters' wish to keep control, which proposal is the most appropriate and why?
options: Proposal (3), since the debenture interest is tax deductible
Proposal (2), since equity dividend need not be paid
Proposal (1), since an overdraft is easy to arrange
Proposal (4), since a mix balances risk, cost and control
explanation: Correct option: (D). No source is free of limitations, so a combination is advisable. Proposal (4) uses retained earnings (no explicit cost), a limited equity issue (keeps the promoters' majority) and moderate debentures (tax-deductible interest without too heavy a fixed burden on fluctuating profits). Proposal (3) alone would place a heavy fixed interest burden on unstable earnings, proposal (2) alone would dilute control, and proposal (1) mismatches a long-term need with a short-term source.
